title: save.loaded
description: Which save the hidden game is running from: sent after session.bound while in game, and whenever the hidden game loads a save or starts a New Game. The server compares it with the player's last save pair (crash recovery).

fresh.description: A New Game that has never been saved (no pair).

pair.description: The save the hidden game loaded or last wrote (save.begin's pair).

at.description: That save's time (Unix seconds), if known.

ops.description: Pokémon operations (party.give, party.take, daycare.deposit, daycare.withdraw) gen1-bridge has sent since that save was loaded or its save.begin went out.

daycare.description: The Pokémon in the hidden game's daycare, if any.

boarded.description: Every Pokémon the hidden game's daycare holds, when it holds more than one (Gen 3's holds two); daycare is the first of them.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
